**DI61** is a medical diagnosis code used in the Danish healthcare system to identify cerebral hemorrhage (*hjerneblødning*). It plays a critical role in the national clinical quality monitoring of patients with [[atrieflimren]], as tracked by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP). 

Specifically, DI61 is one of the primary diagnostic codes used to calculate the incidence of [[intrakraniel-bloedning|Intrakraniel blødning]] among patients with atrial fibrillation. In the clinical indicator definitions, it is grouped alongside [[di60|DI60]], [[di62|DI62]], [[ds064|DS064]], [[ds065|DS065]], and [[ds066|DS066]] to capture all relevant intracranial bleeding events [^src1]. This specific metric is vital for evaluating the safety of anticoagulation therapies in prevalent patient populations [^src1].

Beyond isolated intracranial events, DI61 is also incorporated into a broader composite indicator that measures the incidence of severe bleeding (*alvorlig blødning*) [^src1]. This comprehensive metric aggregates a wide array of diagnosis codes, including those for gastrointestinal bleeding (ranging from [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] to [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]] and [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] to [[dk92-2|DK92.2]]) as well as urinary and respiratory tract bleeding (such as [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], [[dr04|DR04]], and [[dr31|DR31]]) [^src1]. The consistent application of DI61 across the 2023 and 2024 annual reports for Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark underscores its importance as a standardized reference for clinical quality measurement and safety monitoring [^src2] [^src3].

**Diagnostic**
- For incidens af intrakraniel blødning anvendes diagnoserne DI60, DI61, DI62, DS064, DS065 og DS066 [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066)
- For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31)
